conditions.description: D under zero-shot scaffolding (no worked examples)
D under k-shot scaffolding (k = 3 worked examples)
D under k-shot scaffolding plus AutoDoc-style natural-language primitive descriptions (LILO)

declared_outcome_interpretations.efficiency_only: not applicable: no compression arm in this design
declared_outcome_interpretations.h0_consistent: the scaffolding main effect matches or exceeds the representation effect -> consistent with H0 for H14
declared_outcome_interpretations.null_result: mediation share < 0.5 -> any EXP-002 gain is re-described as scaffolding-sensitive; recorded in the negative-result ledger
declared_outcome_interpretations.positive: mediation share >= 0.5 with the representation main effect FDR-corrected -> H14 supported; downstream claims are immune to the scaffolding critique

evaluator_image_digest: <<FILL>>: the image digest the run executes under (ADR-0005)
exclusion_criteria: a fatal transcript leak finding (canary or sealed input on a model-visible surface): the run is aborted and the finding recorded, never a silent exclusion
Exclusion for unfavourable results is prohibited; all exclusions listed with cause.

minimum_interesting_effect.note: H14: the representation effect must survive after partialling out scaffolding. A null rules out that an observed representation gain is a scaffolding artefact - the DSPy critique that gains are prompt optimisation. F and I are held fixed; H is the manipulated variable.

model_identity.claim_limitation: the model role is a fixed-weights language model (ADR-0022); results are Claim Level 1 at most until the evaluator is containerised and the assets relocated (ADR-0005)
model_identity.weights_digest: <<FILL>>: sha256 of the weights, or the provider's immutable snapshot id

power_analysis.variance_source_run: <<FILL>>: E0 re-measured under the model (Exp001Runner.stage_s1 with the model spec)

primary_endpoint: representation_main_effect_after_partialling_out_scaffolding: the share of the D-versus-A held-out solve-rate delta (at fixed FLOPs) attributable to the representation once scaffolding is entered as a factor (per-primitive causal mediation, spec §42)
stopping_rule: Fixed: <<FILL>> seeds per condition (from the power analysis), all conditions run to completion. No interim analysis, no data-dependent stopping. Aborted runs are recorded with their cause, never silently discarded.
